messages:
devon: spotted a squirrel in the atrium with a tiny knit scarf. I nominate it for office mascot :squirrel:
 mia: wait what 😆 photos?
 devon: https://imgur.com/example — he is extremely committed to the snack station 😅
 oliver: vote: yes. if elected, must promise not to chew cables.
 jordan: +1, but only if we build him a tiny desk.
 devon: proposing a campaign slogan: 'For nuts, for us.'
 facilities-bot: FYI: Facilities notified. Please do not feed wildlife. Report any safety concerns to facilities@redwood.com.
 mia: ok but can we at least make a tiny campaign hat out of post-it notes?
 oliver: bring it to the next all-hands as a guest appearance. 
 jordan: motion to create a poll: "Is the office squirrel our mascot?"
 devon: poll: 1) Absolutely 2) Let him remain a mysterious force 3) He can be a departmental mascot
 mia: 1 from me. also, whoever adopts the scarf owes me coffee.
 facilities-bot: Reminder: Do not bring food into the atrium floor after 6pm.
 oliver: noted. I'll set up a responsible observation rotation: 20-min shifts to ensure scarf safety.
 jordan: tagging @everyone is tempting, but I'll spare folks unless we get a formal petition. :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
 devon: closing thread with a promise to deliver a tiny hat prototype by Friday. updates to follow. :hatched_chick:
 mia: eagerly awaiting hat photos. :camera_flash:
 oliver: if the hat is too good we may need to start a merch line. 
 jordan: +1 to merch. squirrel-themed blue mugs?
 devon: noted. raising a hypothetical budget for 'Squirrel PR' to Mia.
 facilities-bot: Update: Animal was guided safely outside by Facilities team at 15:42. No damage observed.
 mia: thank goodness. rescue mission success! :tada:
 devon: wardrobe salvage team on standby.
 oliver: everyone, please refrain from feeding squirrels. They have strong opinions about pastry.
 jordan: thread closed unless further scarf sightings occur.
